summary: BGP routers report problems with a NOTIFICATION message, and one error category covers the finite state machine (FSM). This RFC defines subcodes for it so operators get more detail about what went wrong and can correlate network events. It updates RFC 4271.

eli5.summary: When a machine shows only error, you have to guess. These extra codes are like the machine adding a note about which step went wrong.

questions: what are bgp fsm error subcodes
how to diagnose bgp finite state machine errors
